research.facts:
Las Vegas GP Race Result — Verstappen Wins
**Sources:** formula1.com, racingnews365.com, Yahoo Sports, scuderiafans.com, ABC News
**Verified facts (HIGH):**
- Verstappen won the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix — race time 1:27:39.624, 50 laps
- Podium: Verstappen 1st, Norris 2nd (+0.639s), Piastri 3rd (+1.529s)
- McLaren secured a double podium (Norris P2, Piastri P3)
- Rest of top 10: Kimi Antonelli 4th, Pierre Gasly 5th, Franco Colapinto 6th, Lewis Hamilton 7th, Carlos Sainz 8th, George Russell 9th, Charles Leclerc 10th
- Retirements: Arvid Lindblad, Sergio Perez (DNF); Alex Albon (DNS)
- Race described as "chaotic" with Ferrari collision and five driver grid penalties pre-race
- This is Verstappen's third Las Vegas GP win
**Verified facts (MEDIUM):**
- Verstappen entered Las Vegas with 279 points; left with 304 (25 for win)
